import codecs

def _t():
    encoder = codecs.getincrementalencoder('cp949')()
    assert encoder.encode('파이썬 마을') == b'\xc6\xc4\xc0\xcc\xbd\xe3 \xb8\xb6\xc0\xbb', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('파이썬 마을'), b'\xc6\xc4\xc0\xcc\xbd\xe3 \xb8\xb6\xc0\xbb')
    assert encoder.reset() == None, ('assertEqual', encoder.reset(), None)
    assert encoder.encode('☆∼☆', True) == b'\xa1\xd9\xa1\xad\xa1\xd9', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('☆∼☆', True), b'\xa1\xd9\xa1\xad\xa1\xd9')
    assert encoder.reset() == None, ('assertEqual', encoder.reset(), None)
    assert encoder.encode('', True) == b'', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('', True), b'')
    assert encoder.encode('', False) == b'', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('', False), b'')
    assert encoder.reset() == None, ('assertEqual', encoder.reset(), None)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import codecs

def _t():
    encoder = codecs.getincrementalencoder('euc_jis_2004')()
    initial_state = encoder.getstate()
    assert encoder.encode('æ̀') == b'\xab\xc4', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('æ̀'), b'\xab\xc4')
    encoder.setstate(initial_state)
    assert encoder.encode('æ̀') == b'\xab\xc4', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('æ̀'), b'\xab\xc4')
    assert encoder.encode('æ') == b'', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('æ'), b'')
    partial_state = encoder.getstate()
    assert encoder.encode('̀') == b'\xab\xc4', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('̀'), b'\xab\xc4')
    encoder.setstate(partial_state)
    assert encoder.encode('̀') == b'\xab\xc4', ('assertEqual', encoder.encode('̀'), b'\xab\xc4')

import codecs

def _t():
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('iso2022-jp')()
    ESC = b'\x1b'
    assert decoder.decode(ESC + b'(') == '', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(ESC + b'('), '')
    assert decoder.decode(b'B', True) == '', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'B', True), '')
    assert decoder.decode(ESC + b'$') == '', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(ESC + b'$'), '')
    assert decoder.decode(b'B@$') == '世', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'B@$'), '世')
    assert decoder.decode(b'@$@') == '世', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'@$@'), '世')
    assert decoder.decode(b'$', True) == '世', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'$', True), '世')
    assert decoder.reset() == None, ('assertEqual', decoder.reset(), None)
    assert decoder.decode(b'@$') == '@$', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'@$'), '@$')
    assert decoder.decode(ESC + b'$') == '', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(ESC + b'$'), '')
    try:
        decoder.decode(*(b'', True))
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        pass
    assert decoder.decode(b'B@$') == '世', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'B@$'), '世')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import codecs

def _t():
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('euc_jp')()
    assert decoder.decode(b'\xa4\xa6') == 'う', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'\xa4\xa6'), 'う')
    pending1, _ = decoder.getstate()
    assert pending1 == b'', ('assertEqual', pending1, b'')
    assert decoder.decode(b'\xa4') == '', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'\xa4'), '')
    pending2, flags2 = decoder.getstate()
    assert pending2 == b'\xa4', ('assertEqual', pending2, b'\xa4')
    assert decoder.decode(b'\xa6') == 'う', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'\xa6'), 'う')
    pending3, _ = decoder.getstate()
    assert pending3 == b'', ('assertEqual', pending3, b'')
    decoder.setstate((pending2, flags2))
    assert decoder.decode(b'\xa6') == 'う', ('assertEqual', decoder.decode(b'\xa6'), 'う')
    pending4, _ = decoder.getstate()
    assert pending4 == b'', ('assertEqual', pending4, b'')
    decoder.setstate((b'abc', 123456789))
    assert decoder.getstate() == (b'abc', 123456789), ('assertEqual', decoder.getstate(), (b'abc', 123456789))
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
